item.title: Comment on PHOTOS: First Section Of South Kerry Greenway To Open This Friday by Noel Finnerty
item.description: I totally don't agree with removing railway lines and making them into green ways. I think they should be replaced by new tracks as what is been done between Limerick and Foynes. A Greenway was put in place between Rathkeale and Listowel. In my view, if that was replaced by new rail track, it would reduce the traffic on the road and also save money on parents on students accommodation every year.
